5
Agyidifoɔ ho asodie
1 # Lew 19.32 Mpoopoo w’ani nkyerɛ ɔpanin, na mmom tu no fo sɛ agya, mmeranteɛ sɛ anuanom, 2mmaa mpanimfoɔ sɛ ɛnanom, mmabaa sɛ nua mmaanom wɔ ahoteɛ nyinaa mu.
3 # 1 Ti 5.5 Di mmaa akunafoɔ a wɔyɛ akunafoɔ ampa no ni. 4Na sɛ okunafoɔ bi wɔ mma anaa mmanana a, wɔnsua onyamesom pa wɔn fie mu kane, ntua wɔn awofoɔ ka; ɛfiri sɛ yei na ɛyɛ na ɛsɔ Nyankopɔn ani. 5#Luk 2.37 Na deɛ ɔyɛ okunafoɔ ampa, na aka ne nko no, ɔde n’ani to Nyankopɔn so, na ɔkura nkotosrɛ ne mpaebɔ mu anadwo ne awia. 6Na deɛ ɔbɔ ahohwie no deɛ, ɔyɛ teaseawuo. 7Yeinom ho na hyɛ wɔn, na wɔannya wɔn ho asɛm bi anka. 8Na sɛ obi nhwɛ ɔno ara ne nnipa, ne titire no ne fiefoɔ a, wapa gyidie, na ɔyɛ onipa bɔne sene deɛ ɔnnye nnie.
9Wɔmmfa okunafoɔ a ɔnnya nnii mfirinhyia aduosia nhyɛ mu, na mmom wɔmfa deɛ waware kunu baako, 10#Heb 13.2 deɛ wɔdi no ne ne nnwuma pa ho adanseɛ: Sɛ wayɛne mma, sɛ wayɛ ahɔhoyɛ, sɛ wahohoro ahotefoɔ nan ho, sɛ waboa wɔn a wɔn ho ahia wɔn, sɛ wadi adwuma pa nyinaa akyi.
11Na akunafoɔ a wɔnnyiniiɛ deɛ, mfa wɔn; na sɛ Kristo ho fono wɔn a, na wɔpɛ sɛ wɔwareɛ, 12na wɔnya afobuo sɛ wɔapa kane gyidie no. 13Na emu ara nso na wɔyɛ aniha sua afie mu kyinkyini, na ɛnyɛ aniha nko na wɔyɛ, na wɔyɛ anokurokuro ne terɛterɛ nso keka nsɛm a ɛnsɛ.
14 # 1 Ko 7.9 Enti mepɛ sɛ akunafoɔ a wɔnnyiniiɛ no ware wo mma di efie soɔ, na wɔamma ɔtamfoɔ ho kwan sɛ ɔnni atɛm; 15ɛfiri sɛ ebinom amane akɔdi Satan akyiri dada. 16Sɛ ɔbaa gyidini#5.16 ƆBAA GYIDINI: Anaasɛ: Ɔbarima gyidini. bi wɔ akunafoɔ a, ɔnhwɛ wɔn, na ɔmmma no nnyɛ asafo no adesoa, na asafo no ahwɛ wɔn a wɔyɛ akunafoɔ ampa no.
17 # Rom 12.8 Mpanimfoɔ a wɔhwɛ asafo no so yie no, wɔmfa anidie mmɔho nni wɔn, ne titire no, wɔn a wɔyɛ asɛnka ne nkyerɛkyerɛ ho adwuma. 18#Deut 25.4; 1 Ko 9.9; Luk 10.7 Na atwerɛ no se: Nantwie a ɔpore ayuo no, ma no nni bi, ne: Odwumayɛni akatua sɛ no. 19#Deut 19.15; 2 Ko 13.1 Ntie asafo mu panin ho kwaadubɔ, gye adansefoɔ baanu anaa baasa anomu. 20#Gal 2.14 Wɔn a wɔyɛ bɔne no, yi wɔn atɛn wɔn nyinaa anim, na wɔn a aka no nso asuro.
Adesrɛ ne afotuo
21Mehyɛ wo Onyankopɔn ne Awurade Kristo Yesu ne abɔfoɔ a wɔayi wɔn no anim, sɛ hwɛ yeinom yie, na woampere ho ammu atɛn, nso woanyɛ biribiara nyiyimu so. 22#1 Ti 4.14 Mfa wo nsa ngu obi so ntɛm, nanso mfa wo ho mfra ebinom bɔne mu. Sie wo ho kronn. 23Nnom nsuo nko bio, na wo yafunu ne wo mmerɛ a wotaa yɛ no nti, nom bobesa kakraa bi!
24Nnipa binom bɔne da adi pefee de wɔn kɔ atemmuo mu, na ebinom deɛ nso di wɔn akyi. 25Saa ara na nnwuma pa nso da adi pefee, na sɛ anyɛ saa mpo a, ɛnhunta.

pageProps.chapterText:
Mpoopoo w’ani nkyerɛ ɔpanin, na mmom tu no fo sɛ agya, mmeranteɛ sɛ anuanom, mmaa mpanimfoɔ sɛ ɛnanom, mmabaa sɛ nua mmaanom wɔ ahoteɛ nyinaa mu.
Di mmaa akunafoɔ a wɔyɛ akunafoɔ ampa no ni. Na sɛ okunafoɔ bi wɔ mma anaa mmanana a, wɔnsua onyamesom pa wɔn fie mu kane, ntua wɔn awofoɔ ka; ɛfiri sɛ yei na ɛyɛ na ɛsɔ Nyankopɔn ani. Na deɛ ɔyɛ okunafoɔ ampa, na aka ne nko no, ɔde n’ani to Nyankopɔn so, na ɔkura nkotosrɛ ne mpaebɔ mu anadwo ne awia. Na deɛ ɔbɔ ahohwie no deɛ, ɔyɛ teaseawuo. Yeinom ho na hyɛ wɔn, na wɔannya wɔn ho asɛm bi anka. Na sɛ obi nhwɛ ɔno ara ne nnipa, ne titire no ne fiefoɔ a, wapa gyidie, na ɔyɛ onipa bɔne sene deɛ ɔnnye nnie.
Wɔmmfa okunafoɔ a ɔnnya nnii mfirinhyia aduosia nhyɛ mu, na mmom wɔmfa deɛ waware kunu baako, deɛ wɔdi no ne ne nnwuma pa ho adanseɛ: Sɛ wayɛne mma, sɛ wayɛ ahɔhoyɛ, sɛ wahohoro ahotefoɔ nan ho, sɛ waboa wɔn a wɔn ho ahia wɔn, sɛ wadi adwuma pa nyinaa akyi.
Na akunafoɔ a wɔnnyiniiɛ deɛ, mfa wɔn; na sɛ Kristo ho fono wɔn a, na wɔpɛ sɛ wɔwareɛ, na wɔnya afobuo sɛ wɔapa kane gyidie no. Na emu ara nso na wɔyɛ aniha sua afie mu kyinkyini, na ɛnyɛ aniha nko na wɔyɛ, na wɔyɛ anokurokuro ne terɛterɛ nso keka nsɛm a ɛnsɛ.
Enti mepɛ sɛ akunafoɔ a wɔnnyiniiɛ no ware wo mma di efie soɔ, na wɔamma ɔtamfoɔ ho kwan sɛ ɔnni atɛm; ɛfiri sɛ ebinom amane akɔdi Satan akyiri dada. Sɛ ɔbaa gyidini bi wɔ akunafoɔ a, ɔnhwɛ wɔn, na ɔmmma no nnyɛ asafo no adesoa, na asafo no ahwɛ wɔn a wɔyɛ akunafoɔ ampa no.
Mpanimfoɔ a wɔhwɛ asafo no so yie no, wɔmfa anidie mmɔho nni wɔn, ne titire no, wɔn a wɔyɛ asɛnka ne nkyerɛkyerɛ ho adwuma. Na atwerɛ no se: Nantwie a ɔpore ayuo no, ma no nni bi, ne: Odwumayɛni akatua sɛ no. Ntie asafo mu panin ho kwaadubɔ, gye adansefoɔ baanu anaa baasa anomu. Wɔn a wɔyɛ bɔne no, yi wɔn atɛn wɔn nyinaa anim, na wɔn a aka no nso asuro.

Mehyɛ wo Onyankopɔn ne Awurade Kristo Yesu ne abɔfoɔ a wɔayi wɔn no anim, sɛ hwɛ yeinom yie, na woampere ho ammu atɛn, nso woanyɛ biribiara nyiyimu so. Mfa wo nsa ngu obi so ntɛm, nanso mfa wo ho mfra ebinom bɔne mu. Sie wo ho kronn. Nnom nsuo nko bio, na wo yafunu ne wo mmerɛ a wotaa yɛ no nti, nom bobesa kakraa bi!
Nnipa binom bɔne da adi pefee de wɔn kɔ atemmuo mu, na ebinom deɛ nso di wɔn akyi. Saa ara na nnwuma pa nso da adi pefee, na sɛ anyɛ saa mpo a, ɛnhunta.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
